title: 宝塚記念の後に・『つまんない』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky loses at the Takarazuka Kinen. Having maximized her resourcefulness to no avail, she can feel the reality of her limitations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's bitter toward her rivals, who are already gearing themselves up for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of this has become so played out, she complains—or is something else on her mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She heeds King Halo's directive and decides to run in the autumn Tenno Sho next. An uneasy summer begins…
